note: Cold-start priors for routing goals (design §4.1): what brindle assumes about a profile on a tier before any hosted estimate exists. Per-profile entries are from the bench and routing history (design §0): codex/medium $0.57 a task and 38% clean merges vs sonnet/medium $1.58 and 30%; sonnet on heavy 20 min; Fable as a worker about 2.2x slower (290 s vs 113-158 s). Everything else is a rough tier default: mtok (million tokens a task, at token_mix) is calibrated on sonnet/medium ($1.58 at its list price) and scaled by guess for the other tiers. A profile's $ without its own entry is mtok x its list price (brindle.pricing).
